title: Flatness of a scheme morphism on affine charts
statement: Let $g:X\to Y$ be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme]. Then $g$ is flat [def-weil-flat-morphism] if and only if for every pair of affine opens $U=\operatorname{Spec}B\subseteq X$ and $V=\operatorname{Spec}A\subseteq Y$ with $g(U)\subseteq V$, the induced homomorphism of commutative rings $A=\mathcal O_Y(V)\to\mathcal O_X(U)=B$ is flat, meaning that $B$ is a flat $A$-module [def-weil-pbc-flat-ring-map].

mathlib_searches.query: flat morphism of schemes if and only if induced map on affine coordinate rings is flat

mathlib_searches.results: AlgebraicGeometry.flat_iff : Flat f iff for every affine target open U and affine source open V over U the map f.appLE U V is flat
